c74object.name: evi_sources
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_sources.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_sources.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
A collection of non-oscillator sources and related code. Different types of noise as well as novel random LFOs.

entry.name: audioDust ( )
entry.description:
A variable gain spikey dusty noise source with variable frequency
In 1: type=input: freq, Frequency in Hz
Return 1: dust, The audio dust output
Return 2: white, Synchronised white noise output
Return 3: sync, Full gain sync signal with every piece of dust

entry.name: sparseVelvetNoise ( )
entry.description:
A 'sparse noise' algorithm (similar to 'audioDust()') mixable with a full 'velvet noise' algorithm
In 1: type=input: freq, Frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: mixN,
In 3: type=param (optional): amp, default: 1, The amplitude of the noise, typically left at '1'
Return 1: mixNoise, The mix of sparse and velvet noise
Return 2: sparseNoise, Just the sparse noise algorithm
Return 3: velvetNoise, Just the velvet noise algorithm

entry.name: gaussianNoise ( )
entry.description:
Not-really box-muller gaussian noise distribution implementation
In 1: type=input: gain,
Return 1: gaussian, The gaussian noise output
Return 2: Xoshiro256, Synchronised white noise output
Return 3: cosXos, Synchronised cosine noise output

entry.name: likeZerox ( )
entry.description:
Zero crossing detector, like [zerox~] from RNBO or MSP
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input to be analysed
In 2: type=param (optional): windowSize, default: 0, Window size in samples, default 64, typically vectorsize
In 3: type=param (optional): threshold, default: 0.1, Threshold above which the number of zero crossings reports a count
Return 1: lastCount, Number of crossings in most recent window
Return 2: voiced, Gate triggered by threshold
Return 3: crossing, Current crossings

entry.name: simpleZerox ( )
entry.description:
Simple zero crossing detector with a fixed window sie of vectorsize, a bit like the gen~ example
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input to be analysed
In 2: type=param (optional): threshold, default: 0.1, Threshold above which the number of zero crossings reports a count
Return 1: periodCount, Number of crossings in most recent window
Return 2: voiced, Gate triggered by threshold
Return 3: crossing, Current crossings

entry.name: eviRand ( )
entry.description:
Like [rand~] from MSP (linear), very predictable and gives exact notches
In 1: type=input: p, Phasor driver 0..1 (not frequency)
Return 1: nv, Rand oscillator output
Return 2: n, Internal white noise source sync

entry.name: eviRandN ( )
entry.description:
Like 'eviRand()' but with external noise source
In 1: type=input: p, Phasor driver 0..1 (not frequency)
In 2: type=input: n, External noise source from which rand is derived
Return 1: nv, Rand oscillator output

entry.name: eviRandC ( )
entry.description:
In 1: type=input: p,
Return 1: ,
Return 2: ,
Return 3: ,

entry.name: eviRands ( )
entry.description:
Like 'eviRand()' but ready for cubic interpolation, called by 'eviRandy()'
In 1: type=input: d0, Delta sync of phasor source
In 2: type=input: x2, External noise source from which rand is derived
Return 1: vm1, Cubic interpolator output 1
Return 2: v0, Cubic interpolator output 2
Return 3: v1, Cubic interpolator output 3
Return 4: v2, Cubic interpolator output 4

entry.name: eviRandy ( )
entry.description:
Like 'eviRand()' but cubic interpolated, rolls off much faster
In 1: type=input: p, Phasor driver 0..1 (not frequency)
Return 1: r, Randy oscillator output
Return 2: n, Internal white noise source sync

entry.name: eviRandyN ( )
entry.description:
Like 'eviRandy()' but with external noise source
In 1: type=input: p, Phasor driver 0..1 (not frequency)
In 2: type=input: n, External noise source from which rand is derived
Return 1: r, Randy oscillator output

entry.name: catmullRomSplineDynamic ( )
entry.description:
4-point catmull rom cubic spline interpolator with bias and tension parameters
In 1: type=input: f, Interpolator 0..1
In 2: type=input: y0, Cubic interpolator input 1
In 3: type=input: y1, Cubic interpolator input 2
In 4: type=input: y2, Cubic interpolator input 3
In 5: type=input: y3, Cubic interpolator input 4
In 6: type=input: bias, Bias control, signed
In 7: type=input: tension, Tension control, signed
Return 1: spline, Spline interpolated output

entry.name: eviRandLfo ( )
entry.description:
A very (and needlessly) expensive spline interpolated random LFO
In 1: type=input: hz, Frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: skew, Skew the wave, must be clamped -1..1
In 3: type=input: reset, Hard reset of internal phase
Return 1: r, Random LFO -1..1
Return 2: x, Internal white noise source sync
